import.title: Import CSV
import.subtitle: Import transactions from a file. Useful for trying the app without a bank, or backfilling older data.
import.formatBody: The file must have these five columns in its header. Column order is flexible and names are case-insensitive.
import.hintAmount: Amounts are signed — negative for outflows, positive for income. Use a period as decimal separator.
import.hintCurrency: Currency is a 3-letter code (EUR, USD, …). Leave blank to default to EUR.
import.hintDedupe: Re-importing the same file is safe — duplicate rows are detected by content hash.
import.hintAi: Don't worry if your bank's export looks different — the AI can detect other column names, semicolon delimiters, EU date and number formats, and separate debit/credit columns.
import.pasteLabel: Paste CSV here, or pick a file below
import.errorsTitle: {count, plural, one {# row skipped} other {# rows skipped}}
import.emptyError: The file is empty or no CSV was pasted.
import.fileTooLargeError: File is too large. Max 2 MB.
import.modeAutoHint: Try the standard format first; ask the AI if it doesn't match.
import.modeAiHint: Skip the strict parser and let the AI detect any layout.
import.modeStrictHint: No AI — file must match the canonical header exactly.
import.aiUsedBody: The AI inferred your file's layout and converted it on the fly.
import.aiUnavailableError: Couldn't reach the AI to detect the format. Check your local model is running, or pick "Strict only" mode if your file already matches the canonical header.
import.allRowsFailedError: Every row failed to parse. The detected format may be wrong — try a different file or contact support.
import.cloudConsentRequiredError: AI format detection would call your configured cloud provider. Open Settings → AI Coach and approve cloud-LLM use first, or pick "Strict only" mode.
import.rateLimitedError: Too many AI requests. Please wait a few minutes before trying again, or use "Strict only" mode for now.
import.sampleBody: Don't have a CSV handy? Import 30 realistic transactions across 3 months so you can explore the dashboard, subscriptions, and coach immediately.
import.historyDeleteConfirm: Delete {n} transactions from "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
import.historyDeleteError: Could not delete. Please try again.
import.historyResetAllConfirm: This will permanently delete ALL transactions and import history. This cannot be undone. Are you sure?
import.historyResetAllSuccess: {n} transactions deleted. You can now import fresh data.
import.manualSubtitle: Enter a single transaction directly — useful for cash payments, corrections, or anything not in a bank export.
import.manualSuccess: Transaction added! You can add another one.
import.manualErrorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
import.forceReimportHint: Use this when you're sure the file contains new transactions but the importer is wrongly flagging them as duplicates. Each row will be inserted with a unique id; you can delete the batch later if needed.
import.parsedSampleHint: First row as the importer understood it. If date, amount, merchant, or description look wrong, the AI mapped a column incorrectly.
import.duplicatesBreakdownIntra: {n} rows were collapsed against another row in the same file (identical content)
import.duplicatesBreakdownExisting: {n} rows had hashes that already exist in your database
import.zeroInsertedHint: Nothing was added. Most likely all rows hashed to existing transactions. To override, tick "Force re-import" above and try again.

advisor.title: AI Coach
advisor.empty: Ask me about your spending, budgets, or how to save this month. I only see aggregated numbers, never individual transactions.
advisor.confirmDelete: Delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.
advisor.consentTitle: Send summary to a cloud AI?
advisor.consentBody:
To answer I'll use {provider}. Only aggregated summaries are sent (category totals, budgets) — with anonymized merchant names and no account numbers or individual transactions.

You can revoke this permission anytime in Settings.
advisor.errorRequest: Could not reach the AI. Try again.

form.invalidTarget: Target must be greater than zero.

predictions.title: Predictions
predictions.subtitle: Forecasted spending, income, and savings.
predictions.heading: Predictions
predictions.explainer: We project the next few months from your recent activity. The numbers here come straight from your data — no black box.
predictions.emptyHint: Import or sync at least one month of transactions to see a forecast.
predictions.inputsHint: These are the building blocks of the projection.
predictions.disclaimer: These projections assume your recent pattern continues. Big life changes — a new job, a move, a baby — will shift the numbers.
predictions.habitualHint: Merchants where each charge varies but the monthly total stays in a predictable range — e.g. groceries.
predictions.noRecurringIncomeDetected: We haven't spotted a stable monthly deposit yet. Once we see 3 payroll-style transfers, this will read as fixed income instead of an average.

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.subtitle: Concrete savings ideas and your investor profile.
opportunities.heading: Growth & Opportunities
opportunities.explainer: Each opportunity below is computed from your real numbers. We surface savings wins, goal projections, and emergency-fund targets — never specific investment products.
opportunities.noOpportunities: Nothing flagged right now. Keep going!
opportunities.subOverlapBody: Cutting the cheapest one back saves about {amount}/mo.
opportunities.overspendBody: Bring it back to budget to save about {amount} this month.
opportunities.goalProjectionWithDeadline: You need about {amount}/mo more to hit your {date} target.
opportunities.goalProjectionOpenEnded: Saving {amount}/mo at your current pace gets you there.
opportunities.goalProjectionStalled: Goal stalled — current spending is at or above income, so the saved amount isn't growing.
opportunities.savingsRunwayBody: On the current trajectory you'll save about {amount} in total. That could fund the next chunk of your top goal or boost your emergency fund.
opportunities.savingsRunwayDeficit: On the current trajectory you'd be short by about {amount}. Cutting variable spending or pausing a recurring charge brings this back into the green.
opportunities.emergencyBody: A common rule of thumb: keep 3 to 6 months of expenses liquid. For you that's {three} to {six}.
opportunities.profileSubtitle: Helps the AI Coach personalize the framing of your plan. Stays on this device.
opportunities.profileIntro: Pick the option closest to your situation. Nothing here is shared with anyone — it only personalizes the AI Coach replies.
opportunities.profileError: Couldn't save the profile. Please try again.
opportunities.profileNotePlaceholder: e.g. "Want to retire by 55, prioritize FIRE". This stays on your device and is never sent to the AI.
opportunities.qHorizon: When do you expect to need this money?
opportunities.qRiskTolerance: If your portfolio dropped 20%, you would…
opportunities.qEmergencyFund: Months of expenses you have in liquid savings
opportunities.qDependents: People who depend on you financially
opportunities.qPrimaryGoal: Your top financial priority right now
opportunities.disclaimer: These suggestions are educational planning prompts, not investment advice. We never recommend specific stocks, funds, or financial products. For decisions on individual products, consult a regulated financial advisor.
